newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sasani buys Msomi Hunt Lascaris agency.
newsitem.headline: Sasani buys Msomi Hunt Lascaris agency.

text.p: Recently-listed South African entertainment and communication group Sasani Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired local advertising agency Msomi Hunt Lascaris for an undisclosed sum.
Msomi, which was founded four years ago, will change its name to Sasani Communications.
The buy is Sasani's third acquisition. The firm has already bought Video Lab and the Movie Camera Co.

Msomi has a list of clients that includes blue chips firm such Coca Cola and Standard Bank. "Through a dynamic and passionate management team, the company (Msomi) has demonstrated strong growth over a very short period of time," said Sasani chairman Nic Frangos.

Sasani is to buy 70 percent of the firm with the remaining shareholding being held by senior management. The net price-tag is to be settled partially upfront in cash and also through the issue of Sasani shares at 70 cents each.
The rest of the sum will be settled by three deferred and performance-related cash payments.
